front: What are the five fundamental principles?
back: Integrity, objectivity, professional competence and due care, confidentiality, professional behaviour.
Being straightforward and honest in all professional and business dealings.
Not allowing bias, conflict of interest or the influence of others to override professional judgement.
Not disclosing information obtained through work unless there is a legal or professional duty.
Self-interest, familiarity, intimidation, pressure to manipulate figures, conflict of interest.
Refusing, independent review, documenting instructions, disclosure, consulting a professional body.
Evasion: illegal hiding of income. Avoidance: legal reduction of tax using allowances.
Honesty, respect for people and responsibility to the community in everyday transactions.
Lenders and investors may be misled and lose money; trust in accounts falls.
